title: Put it together: an if inside a loop
idea: REVIEW-LEANING. Recap if-in-loop (act only on some passes) with counter and accumulator review.

exercises.prompt: Recall: a line under an if inside a loop runs when?
options: Only when the condition is true
exercises.explanation: Only on passes where the condition is true.
Even numbers 2 and 4 in 1..5 — the counter ends at 2.

exercises.prompt: Indentation decides whether a line runs every pass, only on matches, or once after the loop.
exercises.explanation: True. Reading the indentation is how you know what runs when.

exercises.prompt:
Review (range): fill the stop so the loop visits numbers 1 to 10:

for i in range(1, ____):
exercises.explanation: Stop one past 10 is 11, so range(1, 11) gives 1..10.

exercises.prompt: Arrange a loop that prints only numbers 1..10 divisible by 4.
exercises.explanation: for header, the if with % 4 == 0, then the indented print.

exercises.prompt: Which numbers print for that divisible-by-4 loop over 1..10?
exercises.explanation: 4 and 8 are divisible by 4 up to 10.

exercises.prompt: An if-in-loop prints its report every pass instead of once. First thing to check?
options: The indentation of the print line
exercises.explanation: The print is likely indented inside the loop; move it out (after the loop) to report once.

exercises.prompt: Big picture: what does an if inside a loop add to your toolbox?
options: Acting only on passes that match a rule
exercises.explanation: 'For each, but only when ...' — you can now act selectively on just the passes that match a rule.
